:::{#def-quantifier}
#### Quantifier

A **quantifier**
[@wikipedia_quantifier_logic]
turns a predicate $P(x)$ (@def-predicate)
about the elements $x$ of a set $S$ into a proposition (@def-proposition).
There are two, each defined next:
the universal quantifier and the existential quantifier. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

:::
